observations.text: The #166 committed results and evidence bind combined_1 and combined_2 to the same PASS digest. Independent recomputation from each preserved 6001-row raw trace yields the sealed SHA-256; qpos, qvel, target, and applied match row-by-row. The evidence also confirms the shared flat model, shared_home reset, adapter, tick-10 first inference, and 1.0 m/s command.

An initial whole-row canonicalization produced a different digest and was rejected after the committed #166 schema-1 analyzer showed that its trace hash covers only qpos, qvel, target, and applied. The source-specific recomputation then matched both sealed traces.
The focused suite ran 65 tests and passed; three tests reported the explicit skip reason native source assets required. Capability-scene parser and zero-step preparation tests ran successfully.

The resulting commit is 00d694dde213fb6862a161374e423261d13ab42b, parented on the frozen starting commit, still detached, and leaves the worktree clean. The logical branch, protocol hash, and diff base validate.

inferences.text: Because the prospective schema-2 analyzer hashes the same four state/command channels with the same canonicalization, the sealed digest will detect a changed flat-reference trajectory with overwhelming SHA-256 confidence even when performance gates still pass.

The runner compares the observed digest after the sentinel trace is written, converts any mismatch to INTEGRITY_STOP, and applies the existing stop/dependency rules. The focused mismatch test confirms one started sentinel claim and NOT_RUN dependent status.
